Season's Greetings to All! This
is OUTLET's third Christmas and
once again we can report steady
growth throughout the year. This
really is YOUR outlet because an
increased proportion of material
comes from readers now and your
ideas influence development.

We've just heard that ABLEX, the
ONLY manufacturer of microdrive
cartridges, HAVE ALREADY STOPPED
PRODUCTION of these devices. As
previously forecast in LOOKOUT,
they first produced a stockpile
and we have done the same so the
microdrive version of OUTLET is
secure for A FEW MONTHS at worst
but ONLY A YEAR or so at best.
Now is the time for microdrivers
to start thinking about a change
- perhaps to a +D or the new SAM
computer!

     Merry Christmas to All!

       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
     605, Loughborough Road
   Birstall,Leicester LE4 4NJ.

body_en:
## Editorial

Season's Greetings to All! This is OUTLET's third Christmas and once again we can report steady growth throughout the year. This really is YOUR outlet because an increased proportion of material comes from readers now and your ideas influence development.

We've just heard that ABLEX, the ONLY manufacturer of microdrive cartridges, HAVE ALREADY STOPPED PRODUCTION of these devices. As previously forecast in LOOKOUT, they first produced a stockpile and we have done the same so the microdrive version of OUTLET is secure for A FEW MONTHS at worst but ONLY A YEAR or so at best. Now is the time for microdrivers to start thinking about a change - perhaps to a +D or the new SAM computer!

Merry Christmas to All!

Ron & Brian Cavers  
CHEZRON SOFTWARE  
605, Loughborough Road  
Birstall, Leicester LE4 4NJ.
body_ru:
## От редакции

С праздниками всех! Это уже третье Рождество OUTLET, и мы вновь можем сообщить о стабильном росте в течение всего года. Это действительно ВАШ outlet, ведь всё большая доля материалов поступает от читателей, а ваши идеи влияют на развитие журнала.

Мы только что узнали, что ABLEX, ЕДИНСТВЕННЫЙ производитель картриджей для микродрайвов, УЖЕ ПРЕКРАТИЛ ПРОИЗВОДСТВО этих устройств. Как уже предсказывалось в LOOKOUT, они сперва создали запас, и мы сделали то же самое, так что микродрайв-версия OUTLET защищена НА НЕСКОЛЬКО МЕСЯЦЕВ как минимум, но ВСЕГО ЛИШЬ НА ГОД в лучшем случае. Пора владельцам микродрайвов задуматься о переходе — возможно, на +D или на новый компьютер SAM!
